description: v4 bright glossy ORANGE lava goo, still a bit see-through (artist 2026-09-26 v4: 'coloring should mathc more this image while remaining a bit see through' -> design/reference/magmoo-v4-color-reference.png: a bright glossy orange lava blob, hotter yellow-orange where the goo thins and drips, deeper orange-red in the shaded undersides). The whole body is molten, so every goo region glows; the glow tiers still grade heat across the goo: deeper orange-red undersides, bright orange body, yellow-orange flow patches and ridges, yellow flame tips (crown points, torn-end tufts, head flame licks, drips, the ball's ears, the goo bridges + shed drips), pale-yellow white-hot core at every torn end (the join faces) and on the droplets. v4 EYES: carved empty sockets only - 'eye' is the socket interior, a DARKER shade of the body red-orange with no glow (no white, no black pupil: the v3 'pupil' region is gone). 'alpha' (0-1, Col alpha = glTF COLOR_0.a) keeps the see-through goo: re-tuned for the lighter colour (a touch denser than v3's 0.55 body so the bright orange still reads as a solid blob); the socket is near-opaque so the carved eyes read. material.alpha multiplies every region (one knob for 'more / less see-through').

goo_cool.note: undersides (smoothed normal pointing down): deeper orange-red goo

goo.note: the body: bright glossy orange lava slime (the reference blob)

goo_hot.note: hotter yellow-orange flow patches (smooth mottling) + ridges

flame.note: flame tips: head flame licks, crown points, torn-end tufts, drip bulbs, finger tips, the ball's ears, the goo bridges + shed drips; the ring round each torn end

core.note: white-hot molten core: the torn (join) end faces, the crater, the droplets

eye.note: v4: the carved empty eye socket - a darker shade of the body red, no glow (emission well under the coolest goo), near-opaque so the socket reads
